verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an AI gateway, but nothing in the evidence documents or measures the latency the gateway itself adds to provider calls. The latency-related items are adjacent features: latency-aware default provider selection, sorting providers by a performance metric, and per-provider timeouts for failover. None of these establishes minimal proxy overhead.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run traffic through gateway infrastructure that adds minimal latency overhead to provider calls
